Cheering Partner – Account Deletion

Official account deletion instructions for Cheering Partner, provided by Cheering Touch Intl.

App and Developer Information

App name: Cheering Partner
Developer: Cheering Touch Intl.
Use the steps below to request deletion of your Cheering Partner account and associated data.

Step 1: Go to Profile → tap Settings

Open the app and tap the Profile tab at the bottom right of the screen. On the Profile page, scroll down and tap Settings.

Step 2: Tap “Delete Account” at the bottom of Settings

Inside Settings, scroll to the bottom of the page. You will see a red Delete Account button. Tap it to continue.

Step 3: Confirm your password

Enter your current password in both fields — Current Password and Re-enter Password — then tap Confirm to proceed.

Step 4: Final confirmation — tap “Yes, Delete”

A confirmation dialog will appear asking Delete Account?. Tap Yes, Delete to permanently delete your account. This action cannot be undone.

⚠ Note: Deleting your account is permanent and cannot be reversed. All your data, orders, and store information will be removed.

Account and Data Deletion

When you confirm deletion in the Cheering Partner app, your account and associated personal data will be submitted for deletion according to the app's deletion process. Please make sure you want to proceed, because account deletion may be irreversible.

Data Retention

Personal data associated with the account will be deleted unless specific information must be retained for legal, security, fraud-prevention, or regulatory reasons. Any information retained for these reasons will be kept only for the period required for that purpose.

Need help? If you cannot access the app or complete the deletion steps, contact Cheering Touch Intl. using the support contact shown on the Cheering Partner Google Play listing.
